errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос (X-ос) е етикетирана с числови стойности
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis itself does not have any labels or tick marks with values. The numerical values are data labels placed next to each bar.
The description claims the horizontal axis has intervals of 100, but there are no visible tick marks or interval labels on the axis itself.

The color representing Croatia is light blue. The description uses the generic term "синьо" (blue), which is imprecise and potentially confusing given that the color for Bulgaria is correctly identified as "тъмносиньо" (dark blue).
